**Agent review** of the whole pull request, at `a23f201`: all 13 files reviewed.

1 finding(s): 1 to consider; 1 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

This PR replaces the inline \"Where is it going?\" panel with a \"Your video is ready\" card in the top-right status-card stack. The card is rendered through `StatusCardPortal`. `StatusCard` gains three optional props: `wide`, `plainIcon` and `badge`. `StatusCardActions` gains `equal`, and `StatusCardButton` gains `title`. All of these default to the old behaviour, so the cards that already use them are unaffected.\n\nWhat I checked:\n- **Page logic:** the conditions for showing the card are unchanged, and leaving the page (including through Edit first) unmounts it.\n- **Tests:** the new unit and page tests cover the chips, More places, Edit first, Open/✕ and the case with no timer.\n- **Messages:** the `postRecording` keys match in en and es, and nothing still references the removed `prepare.panel*` keys.\n- **Docs:** prepare-screen.md matches the new behaviour, and the Settings label it quotes exists.\n- **Dependencies:** `@kaipu/brand` is already a dependency of the desktop app.\n\nI found no defects. There is one optional point: the \"Open\" button only closes the card, and only its tooltip says so.
